    level="1"
    right="Item 15"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Black Scorpion Stingmace](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3202)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=721" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
<trait label="Poison" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=669" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 101

**Price** 6,250 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** 2
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Mace](/Weapons.aspx?ID=362)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The massive stinger of a black scorpion adds significant weight to this _[+2](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2830) [greater striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2829) [fearsome](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2837) [mace](/Weapons.aspx?ID=362)_. On a critical hit, the target is exposed to black scorpion venom.

**Black Scorpion Venom** ([poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=669)) Saving Throw DC 36 Fortitude; Maximum Duration 6 rounds; Stage 1 2d12 poison damage and [clumsy](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61) 2 (1 round); Stage 2 3d12 poison damage, clumsy 2, and [slowed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=92) 1 (1 round); Stage 3 4d12 poison damage, clumsy 4, and slowed 2 (1 round).

**Craft Requirements** The initial raw materials must include the intact stinger of a [black scorpion](/Monsters.aspx?ID=796).

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
name: Black Scorpion Stingmace
